newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: FOCUS-Austria c/bank upbeat on Italy EMU prospects.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Austria c/bank upbeat on Italy EMU prospects.

text.p: Austrian central bank director Adolf Wala said on Tuesday he expected Italy to be part of the first wave of nations to join Europe's planned single currency in January 1999.

"My prognosis is that Italy will be part of monetary union in the first stage," he told reporters during a conference organised by the Austrian National Bank. "If Italy fulfils the criteria we would not hesitate to accept the accession of Italy."

Wala added he also could not rule out that Portugal and Spain, which together with Italy make up the so-called "Club Med", would be able to make the race for early membership in Europe's economic and monetary union.

"Portugal and Spain have presented good figures in the last months. If they are within the necessary frame one has to accept the accession of these countries," he said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
